photos.file: Serrania de la Lindosa rock paintings - giant ground sloth - Iriarte et al 2022.jpg
photos.desc: Serranía de la Lindosa, northwestern Colombia; (a) Giant sloth painting at La Lindosa: 1. massive claws; 2. short rostrum; 3. large head; 4. robust thorax; 5. inverted pes; 6. offspring; 7. miniature
Holotype of Panthera balamoides (CPC-2205) in anterior and posterior views with preserved parts in white, foremen in grey, and missing elements in gray.
